faqs.question: How does the Topstep payout policy work?
faqs.answer: Topstep allows traders to request payouts once they have accumulated 5 active trading days of at least $100 in profit per day since their last payout. The first $10,000 of profits is 100% yours, and any profits beyond that are split 90/10 in your favor.

seo.title: Topstep Payout Policy Explained
seo.metaDescription: Learn how Topstep payouts work, including the 5 active trading days rule, the 100% profit split on your first $10,000, and the standard 90/10 split.

faqs.question: What is the minimum payout amount for Topstep?
faqs.answer: The minimum payout amount for Topstep is $125 when using digital methods like Rise or Crypto. For bank wire transfers, the minimum payout is typically $500.

seo.title: Topstep Minimum Payout Amount
seo.metaDescription: Find out the minimum payout limits for Topstep accounts across different payment methods like Rise, Crypto, and Bank Wire.

faqs.question: How does the Topstep trailing drawdown work?
faqs.answer: Topstep utilizes a Maximum Drawdown that trails your highest account balance (calculated at the end of the trading day). If your account balance drops below this trailing minimum, your account will be breached.

seo.title: Understanding Topstep Trailing Drawdown
seo.metaDescription: A detailed guide on how Topstep's trailing drawdown is calculated at the end of the trading day and how to avoid breaching your account.

faqs.question: What happens if I breach a rule during a payout request?
faqs.answer: If you breach a rule, such as the Daily Loss Limit or Maximum Drawdown, your account will be closed. Any pending payout requests may be forfeited depending on the compliance review of your trading history.

seo.title: Topstep Rule Breach and Payouts
seo.metaDescription: Learn what happens to your pending payouts and account status if you breach a rule like the Daily Loss Limit on Topstep.
